input.description: Customer can filter products by a selected color.
input.acceptance_criteria: Only products matching the selected color are returned.
known_constraints: selected color must match returned products

input.summary: AI product recommendation from retrieved catalogue context
input.description: The assistant recommends products using retrieved catalogue evidence and must not invent unsupported product facts.
input.acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are grounded in retrieved evidence and respect explicit user constraints.

input.description: Checkout validates item availability through an inventory API before confirming an order.
input.acceptance_criteria: Unavailable items cannot be confirmed; inventory API failures return a controlled error and do not create an order.
known_constraints: no order on failed inventory validation
